baseline_prompt_en: A hanging ceramic bowl occupies the center of a bright display room. The bowl hangs from a slender cord beneath a plain wooden beam. The camera taking this photograph looks upward toward the bowl. A pale wall separates its glazed rim and rounded underside from the surrounding space. Soft daylight reveals small variations in the ceramic surface, and a restrained composition keeps the suspended form legible.
